timeline.labelEn: The Free State of Saxony is re-established as a German state

questions.cardDe: Wie heißt das Bauwerk, das rund 4.000 Jahre lang das höchste der Welt war?
questions.de: Wie heißt das Bauwerk, das rund 4.000 Jahre lang das höchste der Welt war?
questions.en: What is the name of the structure that was the tallest in the world for around 4,000 years?

timeline.labelEn: The Great Pyramid of Giza is built as the tomb of Pharaoh Khufu (Cheops)
timeline.labelDe: Die Cheops-Pyramide wird als Grabmal des Pharaos Cheops errichtet

questions.notes: de.wikipedia: originally 146.59 m tall, which made it the world's tallest building for around four thousand years (until it was overtaken by medieval cathedral spires such as Old St Paul's and Lincoln Cathedral, whose spire was the world's tallest from 1311 — so 'around 4,000' is a round figure, nearer 3,800 years). Cheops reigned c. 2620–2580 BC.
